停车最容易出错的时刻，是看到空位就先付钱、随后才发现另一块牌子。湾区没有一套通用: Parking mistakes often begin with paying for an empty space before noticing another sign. There is no universal Bay Area free-parking schedule: rules can differ by block, side of the road and event date even within one city. Check how long you may stay before paying. For longer visits, finding a garage where you can get your car back when you need it usually beats circling the block.
第一步：把整组路牌读完整: Step 1: read the full set of signs
下车查看车位前后路牌，按箭头范围逐项读星期、时段、最长停留和许可例外，再看扫街、: Walk along the space to inspect signs in both directions. Read the arrows, days, hours, maximum stay, and permit exceptions, then check sweeping, loading, commute tow-away, and temporary construction signs. Use the local date and include the next day for an overnight stay. An unpainted curb does not automatically permit parking; intersections, sidewalks, driveways, and hydrants have separate restrictions.
第二步：按城市与日期查，不套用邻城规则: Step 2: check the city and date, not neighboring rules
旧金山另按 SFMTA daylighting 说明检查：有标线或无标线的人行横: In San Francisco, also check SFMTA’s daylighting guidance: generally leave 20 feet clear on the vehicle approach side of a marked or unmarked crosswalk, or 15 feet where there is a curb extension; red curbs or no-parking signs can mark a different distance. On a two-way street, check the right-hand approach in the direction of travel; on a one-way street, check both curbside approaches.
旧金山：咪表收费、扫街与居民许可分别检查。SFMTA 允许实际扫过路缘后停车，但: San Francisco: check meters, sweeping, and residential permits separately. SFMTA permits parking after the sweeper has actually cleaned the curbside, while other restrictions remain; a clean-looking road does not prove sweeping occurred.
Oakland：用官方扫街地图查街段，并看当年节假日表；别照搬旧金山的扫街做法。: Oakland: use the official sweeping map for the block and the relevant year’s holiday list; don’t simply apply San Francisco’s sweeping practice.
San Jose：最长停留看咪表与路牌；停得较久可查 ParkSJ 各车库入口、: San Jose: read maximum stays on the meter and signs. For longer visits, check each ParkSJ garage’s entrance, access hours, and current charges.
San Mateo：市中心有不同停车分区；街边、车库与私人停车场分开查，不把半岛: San Mateo: downtown has different parking zones. Check streets, garages, and private lots separately rather than treating the Peninsula as a single pricing area.
第三步：付款成功，还要看停留有没有超限: Step 3: a successful payment does not extend the legal stay
先看设备要车牌、车位号还是地点代码，再选时长并保存付款结果。手机续费也超不过现场: Check whether payment requires a plate, space number, or location code, then select a duration and save confirmation. A mobile extension does not override the maximum stay or a no-parking period. If payment fails, check the city’s malfunction guidance or move rather than assuming parking is free. San Francisco explicitly does not accept meter payments by QR code; look up other cities’ mobile methods through their own official sites.
最后：把回车时间和备用车库写下来: Finally: record your return time and a backup garage
拍下整组路牌及停车位置，看清当日与次日限制。: Save the full sign set and parking location; check today’s and tomorrow’s restrictions.
付款要对上车辆或车位，设好提前回车提醒。: Make sure the payment matches your vehicle or space and set an early return reminder.
查车库入口、限高、取车时间和活动日收费。: Check garage entrances, height clearance, vehicle retrieval hours, and event-day pricing.
行程延长先判断能否继续停，不把续费当作无限延时。: If plans run late, check whether you may remain instead of assuming payment allows unlimited extensions.
